about_the_game:
Hielo’s struck gold in the latest Crime Boss: Rockay City character pack!

Unlock Golden Boy Hielo and bask in his gold standard loadout. Hielo has always been a little vain but this time he is taking it up a notch with some glittering weapons that are sure to make a statement.

Unique Loadout

• Primary Weapon: Vintovka EB

• Secondary Weapon: DE 44 EB

• Melee Weapon: I-CON

• Unique perks!

• Fire Frenzy Perk: Weapon bonus for intense shooting.

• Psychopath Perk: Consecutive weapon kills temporarily increase weapon accuracy and reduce kickback.

• Dodge Perk: Provides a small chance to ignore received damage for a brief time.

• Equipment: Poison Grenade

All versions of Hielo’s boss appearance will be playable in co-op modes, and his new loadout will carry over to the roguelite campaign.
